items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: the band that I was on, 1944 to ‘46 with Dave Tough and Flip Phillips and Bill Harris and people like that.

ctx.x: Well it depends on when you count. Because Woody had some very good bands, a “Band That Played the Blues,” I don’t think they counted from there. I think they counted from
the band that I was on, 1944 to ‘46 with Dave Tough and Flip Phillips and Bill Harris and people like that.
Was Chubby Jackson on that particular band?
